title: Document to Markdown
description: Give document URLs (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML, CSV, TXT, MD). Each successfully converted document is one result; failed documents return an error row and are free.

urls.title: Document URLs
urls.description: Public http(s) URLs. Private/internal addresses are blocked. Up to 5,000 per run.

chunkSize.title: RAG chunk size (characters)
chunkSize.description: 0 = no chunks. 1000–2000 is typical for embeddings. Chunks follow paragraph and sentence boundaries and keep page numbers.

chunkOverlap.title: Chunk overlap (characters)
chunkOverlap.description: Characters repeated at the start of the next chunk so context is not lost at boundaries (default 150).

maxPages.title: Max pages per PDF
maxPages.description: PDFs with more pages are converted up to this page and a warning is added.

includePageTexts.title: Include page-by-page text (PDF)
includePageTexts.description: Adds pageTexts (one plain-text string per page) to PDF results. Turn off to make rows smaller.

fixCjkVariants.title: Fix broken CJK glyph forms
fixCjkVariants.description: Many PDFs encode characters as Kangxi radicals (⽇ instead of 日). This folds exactly those code points back to normal ideographs.

normalize.title: Unicode NFKC normalisation
normalize.description: Also turns full-width letters/digits into ASCII, half-width kana into full-width, ㈱ into (株). Useful for search; changes the text.

maxFileMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileMb.description: Larger files fail with an error row (free). Maximum 100.

maxChars.title: Max characters per document
maxChars.description: Output is cut at this length and a warning is added.
